definition_of_software_complete: current research and governance state can be inspected from one operator flow
paper-only operation has one deterministic release verdict
risk and drawdown controls fail closed
operator-facing public and founder interfaces have a coherent executive information hierarchy
deployment health and revision provenance are independently checkable
routine dependency maintenance does not create avoidable CI failures
fixed_rules: production stays on the last green main while branch work is tested
CI, CodeQL, or live-boundary security failures block merge
UI work cannot expand research, exchange, order, credential, or capital authority
a failed research hypothesis is recorded; the roadmap does not create rescue tuning
new architecture must remove a release blocker or replace a weaker existing mechanism

lanes.exit_condition: one fail-closed verdict covers paper sandbox, institutional risk, capital-readiness-for-paper, and drawdown kill-switch state
lanes.next: bind the gate into the supported operator flow without adding authority

lanes.exit_condition: public observer reads like a quantitative research control surface rather than a marketing landing page; durable research-state markers remain visible
options: dense executive console with tables and status tape
terminal-style workspace only if density cannot remain readable
split public review site and founder cockpit if one information architecture becomes too compromised
lanes.selection_rule: prefer the least decorative option that makes status, risk, evidence, and next decision legible in under 30 seconds

lanes.exit_condition: one supported command or founder action can inspect prerequisites, run only authorized paper components, and return the operational release verdict with durable evidence
options: thin adapter over existing Mission 63-67 modules
read-only orchestration if historical write interfaces cannot be safely reused
retire stale historical entry points only when current replacements are verified
lanes.selection_rule: reuse verified components; do not rewrite paper, risk, or kill-switch engines unless an invariant cannot be preserved

lanes.exit_condition: scheduled or manual production parity can bind the live observer to an exact main revision without interfering with PR boundary checks
options: existing production-parity workflow with stronger surfaced revision evidence
immutable deployment marker emitted by the worker build
both, if the marker remains independently verifiable
lanes.selection_rule: prefer independent evidence over application self-reporting

lanes.exit_condition: fresh-clone/operator verification, paper release gate, documentation, backup/recovery, and public/founder boundary checks pass together
options: single release checklist backed by machine checks
signed release manifest if provenance needs a stronger artifact
lanes.selection_rule: a human-readable release verdict must be derivable from machine evidence

lanes.exit_condition: DeltaGrid is usable for automated research, backtesting, forward/shadow observation, and durable paper operation without unfinished operator-critical paths
lanes.selection_rule: ship the smallest complete operating system; defer non-blocking features

lanes.exit_condition: an exchange adapter can be tested with credentials isolated, pre-trade limits, reconciliation, and emergency shutdown while real-capital activation remains manual and separately governed
options: exchange testnet/sandbox where behavior is representative
local exchange emulator for failure injection
tiny-capital adapter remains absent if paper evidence does not justify building it
lanes.selection_rule: do not connect real credentials merely to satisfy a calendar date

replan_triggers.trigger: a lane misses its target by more than 48 hours
replan_triggers.action: drop or defer non-blocking work and choose the shortest safe option listed for that lane

replan_triggers.trigger: a new security or authority flaw is verified
replan_triggers.action: promote remediation above UI and feature work

replan_triggers.trigger: an existing verified subsystem already solves the planned work
replan_triggers.action: integrate it instead of building a duplicate

replan_triggers.trigger: a proposed feature cannot name a release blocker it removes
replan_triggers.action: defer it until after software v1
